name: CreatorDB MCP
description:
CreatorDB gives Claude direct access to a database of over 30 million creator profiles across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, refreshed near-daily.

Search for creators by audience size, country, language, engagement, niche, or sponsorship history — in structured filters or plain English. Pull a creator's profile, engagement and consistency metrics, daily metric history, audience demographics, recent content with per-item performance, contact emails, and the brands that have sponsored them.

The same data is available from the brand side: search 15,000+ indexed brands, see which creators they sponsor, and review aggregate sponsorship performance and audience reach.

Typical uses: building a shortlist for an influencer campaign, vetting a creator before outreach, researching which creators a competitor sponsors, and enriching an existing creator list with contact and performance data.

Requires a CreatorDB API key. Calls draw on your account's credit balance; every response reports what it used and what remains, and get_api_usage checks your balance for free.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CreatorDB MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CreatorDB MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.creatordb.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CreatorDB MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CreatorDB MCP lists 45 MCP tools, including get_api_usage, get_instagram_audience, get_instagram_contact, get_instagram_content_detail, get_instagram_performance, get_instagram_performance_history, get_instagram_profile, get_instagram_sponsorship, get_sponsor_audience, get_sponsor_creators, get_sponsor_information, and get_sponsor_performance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CreatorDB MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CreatorDB MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does CreatorDB MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CreatorDB MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CreatorDB MCP is developed by CreatorDB. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
